launches.title: Arva AI — AI agents for instant global KYB onboarding
launches.tagline: We make onboarding onto a bank/fintech as a business 100x faster and significantly cheaper.
launches.body:
# **✨ TL;DR**

[Arva AI](https://arva-ai.com) ([LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/company/arva-ai/)) makes onboarding onto a bank/fintech as a business 100x faster and significantly cheaper. We've built a highly compliant AI agent that instantly handles all low/medium risk manual KYB work in real-time as a customer is onboarding, cutting reviews to seconds and ops spend by 80%.

# **❌ The Problem**

When a business onboards with a bank or fintech, a human analyst has to conduct manual verification over 40% of the time.

**Why is this human review stage a problem?**

* Longer onboarding times cause drop-off from the onboarding funnel (in some cases, up to 50%!). This is a huge revenue loser.
* Large operational overheads to run compliance teams— usually in the millions for large fintechs.
* Humans make mistakes and deviate from procedure.

# **💡 Enter Arva AI**

Arva AI’s agents completely replace human analysts, resulting in instant onboarding for low/medium-risk cases. Arva is a modular solution that can combine with preexisting compliance stacks or completely replace them as an end-to-end platform.

Arva is capable of conducting advanced web due diligence on a business entity, document verification, fraudster checking, handling the back and forth with customers, and much more.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=82926&key=user_uploads/527003/684e6818-ad6c-4495-8ae3-876bda10813a)

**See it in action**

<https://www.loom.com/share/d956b4139f6646649fe0d518caad3386?sid=3b47393f-3078-46b4-8e7a-2d1502a8e702>

# **🙏 Asks**

If you’re a fintech who has to conduct KYB onboarding, we’d love to discuss how we can make your onboarding times 100x faster and save you a bunch of money in the process. Book a demo [here](https://calendar.app.google/tBcxQvpgYmeymkveA), or drop us an email: [rhim@arva-ai.com](mailto:rhim@arva-ai.com). Or if you’re connected to the fintech space and there is someone you can introduce us to, please reach out!

# **🦸 The team**

We’re Rhim (Oxford MEng) and Oli (Cambridge BSc), and we’ve been building products together for a while!

* [Rhim](https://www.linkedin.com/in/rhim-shah/) (CEO) formerly led the FinCrime product team at Revolut Business, where he saw the extent of the manual workload during business onboarding. He also led multiple product teams at Jobandtalent. Prior to that, he was an APM intern at Google.
* [Oli](https://www.linkedin.com/in/oliverfwales/) (CTO) was formerly the lead product engineer at Opvia (YC S20). Before that, he was a full-stack engineer at Iventis, Chimnie, and The Trade Desk.
